intent: User-requested realistic edit of the homepage wall poster
prompt:
Use case: compositing.
Asset type: portrait 4:5 homepage product lifestyle poster for Urban Mynah, full-bleed photograph, no text.
Primary request: Edit image 1 into a convincing real interior photograph. Correct the pasted-on, floating appearance and oversized scale of the Moon Woven dreamcatcher while preserving the quiet earthy aesthetic.
Input images: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and composition/palette reference: sage-green wall, warm wooden console surface, cream tall vase of sparse mustard-yellow billy buttons and low white planter at lower left, Moon Woven on the upper right. Image 2 is the exact PRODUCT IDENTITY REFERENCE, not a background.
Product invariants: faithfully retain this particular handmade object, its asymmetric open crescent of rough natural jute-wrapped twigs, a straight dark wooden inner edge with small white dots, uneven fine cream cotton web with open center, translucent clear tumbled stones secured around the crescent, one pale pink faceted rose-quartz point hanging from the upper right tip, and exactly three pale green oval-bead / clear-quartz strands with successively longer 3, 4 and 5 green beads. Preserve natural handmade asymmetry, exact silhouette and materials. Do not turn it into a conventional circular dreamcatcher or add feathers, leaves, tassels or new ornaments.
Scale and composition: retain the same room arrangement and complete unobstructed product. The complete hanging piece including strands is a small approximately 20 cm tall by 10 cm wide wall ornament; the cream vase is about 23–25 cm tall. Reduce the hanging piece about 20–25 percent from image 1 so these two objects have believable relative size in a consistent photographic perspective. Position it a little lower so it feels connected to this intimate console vignette. Reframe the whole scene modestly closer if needed for useful product detail at homepage size, without making the object oversized. Show a discreet real pin or small hook and short taut natural hanging thread supporting its upper structure. No floating object.
Lighting and realism: one broad soft daylight source from upper left, lighting wall, ceramics, wood and product consistently. The frame sits only 1–2 cm in front of the wall; add delicate short cast shadows down and to the right, darker tight contact shadow at the hanging point and close parts of the frame, lighter narrow shadows under beads and cotton. Shadows should follow the actual silhouette and remain subtle, physically plausible and localized; no dark outline or giant detached shadow. Warm bounced light from the wood, natural occlusion between fiber wraps and knots, restrained translucent beads and quartz, crisp real cotton fibers with gentle natural sharpness.
Wall and setting: tactile matte sage paint on fine plaster, very subtle irregular texture and natural light falloff, not flat green gradient, mottled grunge, plastic or CGI. Preserve sage, cream, warm wood and small ochre accents; soft calm editorial interior photography, not orange or oversaturated. Retain the existing vases/plants, improve their natural grounding and coherent shadows. No extra furniture, no people, no decorative text, no border, no watermarks. Preserve the source product design as closely as possible. High-resolution photographic detail, portrait 4:5 image.
refinementPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target, the newly realistic Moon Woven interior photograph. Image 2 is the exact product reference.
Make one targeted refinement: REDUCE the entire dreamcatcher, including the hanging cord, hook, crescent, pendant and dangling bead strands, to 75% of its current width and height, centered about its current overall center in image 1. Keep it on the right-hand part of the wall. Its complete object from crescent top to lowest bead should be just slightly shorter than the cream vase itself (excluding flower stems). It is a small ~20 cm hanging ornament beside a ~23 cm vase. Preserve the crescent's exact original proportions. The object must be visibly smaller than in image 1, while the vase and all other room features stay exactly the same size and position.
Product fidelity: closely match image 2. Keep the asymmetric jute-wrapped crescent, fine uneven cotton web, clear stones around the frame, dark white-dotted straight inner twig, pink quartz pendant at upper right, and exactly THREE dangling strands. Left strand has THREE pale green oval beads, middle strand has FOUR, and right strand must have FIVE pale green oval beads; use clear quartz chips between them, with progressively longer 3/4/5 lengths. Do not omit the fifth bead on the longest right strand. No added tassels or feathers.
Recalculate only the dreamcatcher's short soft cast shadows to match its smaller size and existing upper-left light; preserve the convincing subtle wall contact and thin thread shadows. Fill the surrounding formerly occupied areas with the same uninterrupted sage wall texture.
Keep ALL other image-1 content unchanged: camera framing, full wall extent, matte wall texture and shade, soft daylight, vase positions and sizes, yellow flowers, green plant, ceramic textures, wooden tabletop, perspective, calm sage/cream/wood palette. Do not zoom, reframe, resize the vases or add objects. No text. Maintain the same portrait aspect ratio and photorealism.
selectedOutput: Second edit: smaller product scale relative to the vase, visible support, fine plaster texture, coherent upper-left light and soft localized cast shadows.
inspection: Compared with the original PDF material-detail image. The source has three green beads on the left strand and four each on the middle and right strands; the output retains that observed pattern.
